**Same-key repeats within 5 minutes now drop.** See [src/router.js:31](src/router.js:31).

`state` holds `lastSentAt`, a key to minute map. Only non-empty routes record a send, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window. Queue sends do count.

`node simulate.js` runs clean. 99 dropped, zero errors.

I read "in the last 5 minutes" as a strict gap under 5. A repeat at exactly 5 minutes sends.

Next: nothing.
